title: 2003 AMC 10B Problem 20
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) \(AB=5\) and \(BC=3.\) Points \(F\) and \(G\) are on \(\overline{CD}\) so that \(DF=1\) and \(GC=2.\) Lines \(AF\) and \(BG\) intersect at \(E.\) Find the area of \(\triangle AEB.\)

solutions.text:
Here \(FG = CD - DF - GC\) \(= 5 - 1 - 2\) \(= 2.\) Let \(h\) be the distance from \(E\) down to line \(CD.\) Since \(\triangle FEG \sim \triangle AEB\) with ratio \(\dfrac{FG}{AB}=\dfrac25,\) we have \[\dfrac{h}{h+3}=\dfrac25,\] so \(h=2.\)

The height of \(\triangle AEB\) from \(E\) to \(AB\) is \(h+3=5,\) giving area \(\dfrac12 \cdot 5 \cdot 5 = \dfrac{25}{2}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: \(\triangle FEG \sim \triangle AEB;\) use the ratio \(\tfrac{FG}{AB}\) to locate the height of \(E\)
